properties.note: Matrix: fine grained, grey, magnetic, olivine and calcite. Macrocrysts: olivine <3cm, ilmenite <1.5 cm, deep red garnet <1 cm (fairly abundant), clinopyroxene <1.5 cm.

properties.desc: Overall homogenous with many macrocrysts. Flow banding at rim with higher calcite content (ligther grey colour). Generally few thin calcite veins but sometimes more and thicker <1 cm. Few crustal xenoliths <10 cm.

properties.desc: Less than 5 m N of WP 40 is another dyke in situ c. 0.5 m wide and at least 6 m long. Striking c. 115 but curving a little. Dip: 50 SW. Calcite-rich rims with some flow banding.
properties.note: No xenoliths observed. Not as many macrocrysts as the other dyke (WP 38-39-40). Matrix: fine-medium grained, dark grey, magnetic, olivine and calcite.

properties.desc: Overall homogenous with many macrocrysts. Few crustal xenoliths c. 5-10 cm. Flow banding at least at one rim (to the North). Calcite veins in flow banding area. Matrix: fine grained, grey, magnetic, olivine and calcite.
properties.note: Macrocrysts: olivine <3 cm, ilmenite <1 cm, deep red garnet <0.7 cm, some with rim.

properties.desc: A continuation of WP 42 with grassy area in between. Same characteristics as WP 42. The dyke can not be traced any further after this point.
Flow banding. Xenoliths: crustal 5-15 cm. Mantle c. 5 cm, eclogitic. Calcite veins. Many large macrocrysts: red garnet <2 cm. Olivine <2 cm. Ilmenite <2 cm, abundant. Clinopyroxene <3 cm.
properties.note: Dimension1 is a minimum.

properties.desc: Found under gneiss overhang. Flow banding. No xenoliths observed. Matrix: fine grained, weakly magnetic, blueish grey crystals <2 mm. Few macrocrysts, all < 0.5 cm, mostly olivine and some ilmenite.
Similar to WP 49. Most macrocrysts at boundary in flow banding area.

Homogenous with many macrocrysts. Few thin (<2mm) calcite veins. No xenoliths observed. Matrix: fine-medium grained, light grey, magnetic, olivine, calcite. More calcite along rim. Macrocrysts: deep red garnet < 1cm.
properties.note: Olivine <1 cm. Ilmenite <0.5 cm.

properties.desc: Within gneiss wall. Overall homogenous. Few flow bands at boundaries. Calcite veins at boundaries up to 3 cm wide.
properties.note: No xenoliths observed. Matrix: fine-medium grained, dark grey, magnetic, olivine and calcite. Macrocrysts: olivine <0.5 cm. Ilmenite <0.3 cm.

properties.desc: 2 thinner dykes in situ next to subcrop from the dyke at WP 56. The strike is approximate since the dykes curves somewhat. One dyke c. 10 cm wide, no macrocrysts, calcite-rich matrix.
properties.note: One dyke c. 20 cm wide, moderate amount of macrocrysts: abundant olivine <1 cm. Ilmenite <0.5 cm. Deep red garnet <1.5 cm. Few clinopyroxene <1 cm.

properties.desc: 3 parallel dykes; Top one: c. 25 cm wide. Homogenous. Fair amount of macrocrysts: deep red garnet <1.2 cm. Clinopyroxene <1 cm. Olivine < 1 cm. Ilmenite <1 cm. All seems to be equally abundant. Middle one: c. 45 cm wide.
properties.note: No macrocrysts in up side, many in down side also showing banding + greenish colour on surface. Macrocrysts: mostly olivine <2 cm. Deep red garnet < 2 cm. Few crustal xenoliths < 2 cm.

properties.desc: A continuation of the 3 parallel dykes described in WP 59.
Starting in gneiss getting at least 1.5 m wide within the first meter from beginning point. Heterogenous, in places more calcite. Xenoliths, both crustal and mantle < 15 cm.
properties.note: Many macrocrysts: orange + deep red garnet < 2cm. Ilmenite < 1cm. Olivine < 2 cm. Clinopyroxene <2 cm. All abundant.

properties.desc: Bluish colour on surface. Homogenous texture. Matrix: fine grained, dark grey. Fair amount of macrocrysts: mostly serpentinized olivine < 1 cm. Few orange-red garnets <1 cm.
2 dykes; Top one: a continuation of dyke at WP 62, 40 cm wide, flow banding, rich in macrocrysts: garnet <1 cm, olivine < 2 cm, ilmenite < 1 cm. Same bluish green colour but only at rims.
properties.note: "Normal" brown colour in the middle - thin calcite veins at rims. Strike/dip: 90/12S. Bottom one: at least 40 cm wide, overall bluish-green colour on surface, overall homogenous. Macrocrysts: serpentinized olivine < 1cm, garnet < 1 cm.

properties.desc: A continuation of the two dykes at WP 63.

Heterogenous: one area with excessive xenoliths < 8 cm both crustal and mantle. Large macrocrysts: deep red garnet < 3cm. Ilmenite < 5 cm. Clinopyroxene and olivine. Another area with less and more normal size macrocrysts (<1 cm).

Overall homogenous but some areas with calcite clusters, not veins. No xenoliths observed. Very few macrocrysts: olivine <0.5 cm. Few ilmenite < 0.3 cm. Deep red garnet < 0.4 cm. Matrix: magnetic, fine grained, grey, olivine + calcite.

A continuation of WP 81. Weakly developed flow banding. Few xenoliths, altered, <1.5 cm. Matrix: light grey-greenish, medium grained, large content of olivine. Macrocrysts: olivine < 1 cm, abundant. Few ilmenite < 1 cm. Possibly garnet w. rim < 0.3 cm.

A continuation of WP 82. Homogenous. Crustal xenoliths 10-15 cm. Fair amount of macrocrysts. Matrix: light grey-greenish. Medium grained. Olivine-rich. Calcite. Macrocrysts: Olivine < 1 cm. Ilmenite < 1 cm. Purple garnet < 0.5 cm.
A continuation of WP 84. Same characteristica as WP 83.

Banding: 3-4 cm wide layers at boundary. Alternating macrocrysts (olivine and garnet) and fine grained (calcite-rich) layers. Few calcite veins. Few mantle xenoliths < 3 cm. Matrix: grey-greenish. Medium grained.
properties.note: Olivine-rich. Macrocrysts: Olivine < 1cm. Ilmenite < 0.5 cm. Red and purple garnet < 0.5 cm. Few orange garnets. Some garnets with rim. Garnet fairly abundant.

properties.desc: In scar continued from WP 92. Matrix: fine grained, dark grey, areas with calcite-enrichment. Macrocrysts: olivine < 1.5 cm. some serpentinized. No garnets observed. No xenoliths observed. Surface altered and covered in moss.
properties.note: Dimension1 and Dimension2 are minimums.

properties.desc: Homogenous. Almost no macrocrysts. Matrix: fine grained, dark grey. Macrocrysts: olivine < 0.5 cm.
properties.note: Dimension1 is a minimum.

properties.desc: Flow banding. Calcite veins < 1 cm wide. Few crustal xenoliths < 20 cm. Matrix: fine grained, grey, olivine, calcite. Many macrocrysts: olivine < 0.7 cm, serpentinized. Deep red garnet < 0.3 cm.

Homogenous with flow banding at boundaries + calcite veins at boundary; 10 cm wide area with several veins of greenish white colour. Few crustal xenoliths < 3cm. Matrix: fine-medium grained, light grey, calcite-rich, olivine.
properties.note: Macrocrysts: olivine < 0.7 cm. Few, deep red garnet < 0.4 cm. Ilmenite < 0.4 cm.
